reviews.feedback: internal/store/types.go:251-252: PreviousSecret and PreviousSecretUntil are tagged json:"-", but the snapshot (internal/snapshot/snapshot.go:30, via State.WebhookEndpoints in internal/store/state.go:22) persists the store as JSON. After a restart within 24h of a rotation, the previous secret is lost and deliveries carry only one v1 entry, violating the 24-hour overlap requirement. Keep the fields out of the API response but persist them in snapshots (e.g. snapshot-visible JSON tags with the API layer clearing them in rotateSecret/updateEndpoint responses, or a separate snapshot DTO). Add a test that saves and reloads a snapshot after RotateSecret and checks that the delivery header still carries both v1 entries.
